the development of a novel, highly accurate trace clustering technique that is capable of splitting up event logs so as to facilitate process discovery from complex and flexible environments.
the development of a trace clustering technique that is able to improve the accuracy and comprehensibility of process models discovered from highly flexible event logs.

the development of a trace clustering approach for improved process discovery that can be applied to event logs from highly flexible environments, which are often characterized by a large variety of processes.
